transcriber_notes: English twin of nodate_vermilion_2013_01_31_fr_237e63 (same pit; the chart and table area is pixel-identical to the French export, so all measurements carry over). 706x911 JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form (English labels), no app branding -> source_format 'other'. DATE CONFLICT: printed date 30/01/2013 (D/M/Y) vs file name 2013-01-31; printed date recorded, record_id unchanged. Altitude printed 2000 m while the 2013-02-12 Vermillion Plot chart prints 2200 m; transcribed as printed. Height axis 2.70 px/cm (200 cm at y=302, 0 at y=842). Boundaries from blue bar edges/boundary lines and the table leader lines: 167/133/132/114/113/49/32/27/0 (+-0.5 cm). The two SH layers are ~1 cm thin: bars stop at 133 and resume at 132 (and 114/113) with no bar in between, and the table R cells hold only placeholder dots, so their hardness is blank. Hardness axis geometric (bars grow leftward from the right edge x=329): F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px; bar widths 13 (F), 47 (1F-), 67 (1F+), 108 (P), 94 (P-); every +/- reading is confirmed by the '+'/'-' mark under the R-column hardness symbol. Temperature axis 13.5 px/C with 0 C at x=302 (0 label gridline); circle markers read to +-0.1 C; the 167 cm reading (-4.1) matches the printed surface temperature. The dashed line above the surface ends near -3.9 C at the top (air temp -3.8 printed; not recorded as snow temperature). No marker at 90/70/50/30/0 cm. theta (moisture) and HW/rho columns blank for all layers.
